dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['amenity'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['man_made'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['shop'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['tourism'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [amenity](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity) - [man_made](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:man_made) - [shop](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:shop) - [tourism](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism) - [opening_hours](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:opening_hours) - [beds](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:beds) - [rooms](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:rooms) - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:housenumber](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:housenumber) - [addr:street](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:street) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
